verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms LiteLLM serves a populated llms.txt at docs.litellm.ai/llms.txt, which indexes its docs (e.g., the LiteLLM Overview), so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Several doc pages are also sourced as .md URLs, but the generic docs/.md markdown probe returned 404. Missing for 10: consistent markdown variants of every docs page, first-party documentation describing agent-oriented doc usage, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
